name: Town Center & Clock Tower
tagline: The walkable heart by the river
description: The compact core around the clock tower, central market, and main guesthouses sits close to the Thanlwin riverside. Most travellers base here for easy access to restaurants, tour pickups, and evening strolls, with everything reachable on foot within a few relaxed minutes.
bestFor: First-time visitors and short stays wanting everything walkable
pros: Most guesthouses, eateries, and tour operators here
Close to the market and riverside sunsets
cons: Can be noisy and busy by day

name: Mount Zwegabin & Lumbini Garden Side
tagline: Under the shadow of the great massif
description: South of town toward Mount Zwegabin, this rural area holds the Lumbini garden with its rows of Buddha statues and the trailhead for the strenuous climb to the summit monastery. It is scenic, quiet, and best explored by motorbike or tour as a day trip.
bestFor: Hikers and those chasing the iconic karst views
pros: Stunning views of the Zwegabin massif
Lumbini garden's rows of Buddha statues
cons: Little accommodation, mostly a day-trip area
Needs transport to reach and explore

name: Sadan Cave & Kyauk Ka Lat Area
tagline: Caves, karst pinnacles, and lake pagodas
description: To the south lie some of the region's signature sights: the vast Sadan Cave you can walk through, and the Kyauk Ka Lat pagoda perched on a karst pinnacle rising from a lake. This is countryside touring territory rather than a place to stay, reached by motorbike or tour.
bestFor: Cave explorers and photographers on day trips
pros: Walk-through Sadan Cave and boat exit
Dramatic Kyauk Ka Lat lake pagoda
cons: Sites can be muddy or hard to reach in monsoon

name: Thanlwin Riverside & Cave Road
tagline: Sunsets, boats, and the road to the caves
description: Along the Thanlwin river and the road leading out toward the bat cave and Kaw Ka Thawng, this fringe of town offers waterside guesthouses, boat trips, and easy access to the famous sunset bat exodus. It blends riverside calm with a launchpad for exploring.
bestFor: Slow travellers who love water and sunsets
pros: Beautiful river views and boat trips
cons: A little removed from central services
Limited dining right on the riverside
